intent: Add GitHub OAuth login to a FastAPI Python API, replacing JWT auth, targeting staging deployment within two weeks.

nodes.title: Research and select OAuth library
nodes.description: Evaluate authlib, fastapi-users, and python-social-auth for GitHub OAuth2 support with FastAPI.
acceptance_criteria: GitHub OAuth2 compatibility confirmed for chosen library

nodes.title: Assess auth module test coverage
nodes.description: Map current test coverage of the auth module. Identify gaps that could hide regressions during JWT to OAuth migration.
outputs: List of untested auth code paths
acceptance_criteria: Coverage report generated for auth module

nodes.title: Implement GitHub OAuth login endpoints
nodes.description: Add /auth/github and /auth/github/callback endpoints. Update session management. Do not remove JWT in this step.
acceptance_criteria: User can initiate GitHub OAuth login
Callback stores GitHub user ID in session
unknowns: Whether existing session model can be extended or must be replaced

nodes.title: Risk: Active JWT sessions invalidated on cutover
nodes.description: When JWT auth is removed, active sessions are invalidated. Users will be logged out. Requires migration window and rollback plan.
unknowns: Number of active sessions at planned cutover time

nodes.title: Tech lead approves JWT auth removal
nodes.description: Per company policy, tech lead must explicitly approve removal of JWT. Cannot be automated. OAuth must be verified on staging and rollback plan ready.

nodes.title: Remove JWT authentication system
nodes.description: Remove JWT middleware, token issuance, and validation after tech lead approval. Update all tests. Redeploy to staging.

assumptions: GitHub OAuth app will be created before implementation
unknowns: Whether existing session model can be extended or must be replaced
Active session count at cutover time

blind_spots.text: Auth module test coverage has ~40% gap
Active JWT sessions will be invalidated on cutover
No rollback plan exists — must be created before gate
Tech lead must explicitly approve JWT removal

open_questions: Can the existing session model be extended or must it be replaced?
What is the planned maintenance window for JWT cutover?

do_not_assume: Tech lead approval for JWT removal
